verdict_basis: Source review of the supplied files at this head. Resolved: R1-R9, N1-N4, round-3 NEW-1 and NEW-2, and round-4 NEW-3. Still open: NEW-4 (medium) is only partly resolved because TeamSync::admit_member signs commits from a clock that never observes received HLCs. NEW-5 (low) is only partly resolved because several paths still broadcast while holding the state lock. One new low finding (NEW-6): live pickup of local facts ignores local admission receipts and the historical-revocation rule. Source PASS requires zero unresolved findings, so the verdict is REVISE. Execution gates are listed separately and are not satisfied for this head.

residual_notes: Migration caveat, by design: a pre-receipt member_removed line whose author later lost authority through a commit is quarantined on first cold load, which reactivates the target locally. This matters only for state written by pre-receipt builds (no public releases yet). Document it, or bootstrap receipts for legacy lines, before supporting upgrades.

evidence: Resolved part: author_commit observes every stored commit HLC and the author's own previous commit. rotate_dek_bound fails closed if the new generation did not become current. removal_repair_sorts_after_a_received_future_rotation covers a peer rotation 4 minutes ahead.

Remaining gap: TeamSync::admit_member signs member.add with env.hlc.tick(None). env.hlc observes commits only inside publish_fact. handle_commit, submit_commit and register_env never advance it, and after a restart it starts at 0.
Consequence 1: a member.add can sort before commits this node has already received.

Consequence 2: if this node's previous own commit carries an HLC above wall time (author_commit having observed a peer commit up to MAX_CLOCK_SKEW_MS ahead), receive_commit rejects member.add as team_hlc_not_monotone.

on_inbound_session discards the error (`let _ = self.admit_member`), and the invitation was already marked used in consume_invite. Enrollment therefore fails silently, and the joining node times out with a burned invitation.
resolution_conditions: In admit_member, build the HLC the way author_commit does: observe all store commits and the author's previous commit, under the state lock, before ticking. Alternatively, route admission through membership::author_commit.
Audit admission failures instead of discarding them.
Add a test: receive a peer commit about 4 minutes ahead, author a local commit, then admit an invited device. Assert member.add is accepted and sorts after the observed commits.

evidence: Resolved part: handle_fact and publish_fact drop the state lock before audit, broadcast and removal notices. store_fact writes the receipt before taking the envs mutex. Receipts are append-structured (fact_admissions.jsonl).
Remaining gap: StateDir::lock is re-entrant per thread, so in these chains the outer lock stays held across TeamSync::submit_commit's broadcast and publish_fact's broadcast and notices:
membership::author_commit (lock for the whole function) → team.submit_commit → broadcast.
remove_member (lock for the whole function) → author_fact → publish_fact.
repair_member_removals → ensure_removal_rotations → rotate_dek_bound → author_commit.
A blocking peer send in any of these stalls every local state transaction, including the admin CLI.
resolution_conditions: Have submit_commit and publish_fact queue messages that are sent after the outermost lock is released, or restructure the callers to release the lock before calling into TeamSync's send paths.
Alternatively, document and enforce a bounded, non-blocking Session::send.

new_findings.title: Live pickup of local facts ignores local admission receipts and the historical-revocation rule, so it can quarantine a fact the CLI admitted and applied
evidence: membership::author_fact (team=None) checks current authority under the state lock, writes a signed local receipt, appends the line, and runs refold_and_derive. The connection is disabled or the version revoked locally, and the CLI reports success.

The running serve later sees the line in pick_up_local_facts (about every 50 ms). It validates only with validate_incoming_fact against authority at that moment. It never consults fact_admissions.jsonl and never applies load_facts' historical-admin rule.

If a peer commit demoting or removing the authoring admin arrives between the CLI append and the serve poll, quarantine_local_fact deletes the receipted line from facts.jsonl. Serve's next refold and derive_local then re-enable the connection or version locally, which undoes an irreversible revocation.
After a restart, load_facts would have admitted that same line by receipt, so the two admission paths disagree.
rejected_removals surfaces only member_removed conflicts, so a dropped revocation is not shown in status.
resolution_conditions: In pick_up_local_facts, admit a line that has a valid local admission receipt, or that passes the same historical rule as load_facts, before falling back to current-authority validation. Factoring one shared admission function would prevent drift.
Add a test: CLI author_fact connection_disabled, then a received member.set_role demotion of the author, then a serve poll. Assert the fact is retained and the connection stays disabled.

execution_gates.note: The supplied evidence does not state its commit SHA. It ran in a worktree, and none of it can be attributed to 9060791 without that binding.

non_findings_checked: Lock order is the state lock, then the envs mutex, everywhere. invite_check takes the state lock (consume_invite) before envs. No path takes the state lock while holding envs.
author_commit's guard, ensure_removal_rotations and rotate_dek_bound all run under one re-entrant state lock. A concurrently received rotation cannot slip in between the guard and the write.
repair_member_removals snapshots pending hashes. A hash added during repair is retained for the next pass.
load_facts indexes receipts with Value::Index, which returns Null on a non-object document, so a corrupt fact_admissions.json cannot panic it.
Peer-supplied facts always pass current-authority validation before store_fact. The historical rule is reachable only for lines already in local facts.jsonl.
verify_linkage regexes cover libssl and libcrypto (dylib and so) and Homebrew prefixes. controlled_environment re-adds only OPENSSL_DIR, OPENSSL_STATIC and CARGO_TARGET_DIR.
limitations: Static review only. Nothing was built or run, and the file SHA-256 values were not checked against the head.

Transport, vault and CLI callers, incident.rs and smtp.rs were not supplied. Session::send blocking behavior (relevant to NEW-5) and whether every production shared-secret write goes through membership::author_commit are unverified.
